title.zh: 查询API历史发布的版本列表

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放API的用户，有过发布的API才有历史版本记录
- 调用该接口能获取API历史版本号数据，用于其他接口的调用
descriptions.en:
*   This operation is intended for API providers. Only APIs that have been published have historical version records.
*   This operation allows you to obtain the historical versions of an API. This operation is always called by other operations.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-api-histories --group-id 1084f9034c744137901057206b39d2b6 --stage-name RELEASE --api-id c076144d7878437b8f82fb85890ce6a0 --api-name weather --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
